detector.confidence_note: Detector scores are not calibrated probabilities; OpenCV HOG scores are only ranking proxies.

reid.note: Appearance is an anonymous association cue only; never a confirmed physical identity.

identity_policy.note: A person seen in multiple uploaded camera videos can be counted once per camera. Cross-camera candidate links do not merge these IDs.

group_settings.distance_note: Bounding-box height is used only as an image-space perspective scale proxy, with a robust larger-box allowance; biological height is not inferred.
group_settings.group_meaning: Temporary observed proximity/co-movement only; no family or relationship inference.

stationary_role_candidates.note: Long presence with a small image-space movement radius; this is not a confirmed staff/cashier label.

group_assignment_policy.note: An existing group preference is retained unless a competing group is sustained and materially stronger.

cross_camera_policy.note: Candidate links require user-supplied offsets on one synchronized timeline. Candidate links are not identity decisions and do not change counts.

limitations: Visitor IDs are anonymous and camera-local; counts across camera videos are not deduplicated.
Group labels represent temporary proximity/co-movement, not family or personal relationships.
Stationary-role candidates are heuristic suggestions, not confirmed staff/cashier labels.
Checkout-camera presence is not proof of a payment. No POS transaction feed was provided.
Confidence values are not calibrated; validate against manually labelled footage before business use.
No age, gender, face identity, intent, or theft classification is performed.
